newsitem.title: USA: Telebras rises on court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Telebras rises on court ruling.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras SA rose on Monday on news a Brazilian court had rejected a request for an order suspending cellular telephone concessions, traders said.
"This ruling is helping, obviously," a trader said. "The stock has been under a fair amount of pressure, and today it's just getting back to where it was a few days ago."

State-run Telebras was up 4-1/2 to 99-3/8, close to its 12-month intraday high, in late afternoon. Volume was 2.1 million shares, putting the ADRs among the most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange.

A Brazilian judge rejected a request for an order sought by a telecommunications workers' union. The union wanted to suspend the reformist government's program to offer B Band cellular telephone concessions to the private sector.
The case was separate to a challenge to the program in the Supreme Court brought by leftist parties.
